label: Toggle
description: A yes/no value, such as "Confirmed by requester", "VIP", or "Major incident". A toggle is never empty: null and missing values read as false. Use a single_select when there is a meaningful third state (e.g. unknown).
usage: Label toggles as a positive statement ("Confirmed", not "Not confirmed").
Use a validation rule (record.confirmed == true) to require the toggle to be on; required has no effect because false is a value.
Use for flags that drive rules or views.
constraints: Never null: null and missing values are stored and read as false.
default must be a boolean (default false).
required is ignored for toggles; the compiler warns when it is set.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Space toggles; Enter commits an inline edit.
accessibility.notes: aria-checked reflects the value; the on/off state is shown as text as well as position.

responsive: Inline with its label at all widths.
